tools.name: search_creators
tools.description: Search Kolect's database of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube creators. Give a plain-language brief (any language: market, niche, follower range, content style, audience...), or similar_to (a profile link, @handle or creator id) to find lookalike creators, or both. Costs the user's credits: 1 credit per

tools.name: load_more_results
tools.description: Get more new creators for one of the user's earlier searches. Costs 1 credit per 2 new creators returned. Calling again right away with the same arguments returns the same page without charging.

tools.name: get_search_results
tools.description: Read creators already delivered by one of the user's earlier searches (free). Use next_cursor to page through them. To get new creators beyond those already delivered, use load_more_results.

tools.name: lookup_creators
tools.description: Check whether specific creators are in Kolect's database, by profile link or @handle, and get their creator ids (needed for check_fake_followers, get_emails and save_creators). tools.name: check_fake_followers
tools.description: Estimate how real up to 20 creators' followers are, from public views, engagement, likes and following. Creator ids must come from this user's searches (pass search_id), lookups or saved creators. The first checks each day are free (see get_account), then 5 credits each; creators without enough data

tools.name: get_emails
tools.description: Get public contact emails for up to 20 creators. Free for creators from this user's search results (pass search_id; the search already paid for them) and for ones unlocked before. tools.name: save_creators
tools.description: Save creators to the user's Kolect favorites, optionally into a collection (an existing collection's name or id; a new name creates it). Free. Creator ids must come from this user's searches (pass search_id), lookups or saved creators. Saved creators appear on the Kolect website, where the user can

tools.name: list_saved_creators
tools.description: List the user's saved creators (all, or one collection by name or id) with current follower and view numbers, plus the user's collections. Free. Good for building a shortlist, a report or a spreadsheet.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The user's Kolect plan, credit balance, today's free fake-follower checks and email unlocks, lookup limits, this key's daily credit limit, and their collections. Free. Check it before a large paid step.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_emails, get_account · Private data: search_creators, lookup_creators, get_emails, save_creators · Public sink: get_emails, get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_emails, get_account · Private data: search_creators, lookup_creators, get_emails, save_creators · Public sink: get_emails, get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
